capabilities: Turn note properties into app panels with buttons, forms and charts
Add board, calendar, timeline, chart and number views to Bases
Log rows from a prompt, hotkey, inline line or URL
Import and reconcile bank, broker and health CSV, JSON and ICS files
Share a kind between vaults with end-to-end encryption
extras: No telemetry, no account, no AI; optional gizmod Node script runs apps while Obsidian is closed; full documentation lives in an external cookbook and reference.
intentEvidence: Instead of installing a dozen single-purpose plugins or locking your life in a hidden database
motivation: The author wanted every app to be a plain Markdown note in the vault rather than a dozen single-purpose plugins or a hidden database.
problem: Building a tracker or dashboard in Obsidian means installing and hand-wiring several single-purpose plugins, queries and CSS.
